title: ingest.object.deleted payload (v1)
description: Payload of the ingest.object.deleted outbox event. vault_sync emits canonical lifecycle identity in uuid/object_id and retained frontmatter continuity in vault_uuid. app/workers/outbox_worker.py::handle_ingest_object_deleted uses canonical object_id to purge vectors. The schema pins the emitted shape without over-constraining other consumers.
